# Texas Sugar Daddies

> San Antonio-based custom bakery, catering company, and event venue founded by two foodie dads in 2017. Specializing in custom cakes, desserts, full-service catering, and venue rentals.

## Services
- Bakery: Custom cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and personalized sugar cookies with custom photo/logo printing. Specialties for birthdays, weddings, baby showers, and corporate events
- Cafe: Open Tuesday–Thursday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM. Daily specials, salad bar, lunch options, and grab-and-go items
- Catering: Custom menus for onsite and offsite events — weddings, corporate meetings, anniversaries, private parties. Professional chefs, full-service setup
- Venue Rental: Event space accommodating up to 150 guests with full amenities

## What We're Known For
- Custom desserts made with premium ingredients
- Free delivery on orders over $10
- 500+ clients served, 5-star reviews
- Made with pride in San Antonio, Texas
- Tagline: "Life is short, eat dessert first!"

## About
Texas Sugar Daddies is a San Antonio bakery, catering company, and event venue founded in 2017 by two foodie dads who left corporate careers to follow their passion for food. The business serves the San Antonio community with custom cakes and desserts, a weekday cafe, full-service catering for events of all sizes, and a rental venue that holds up to 150 guests. Known for quality ingredients, creative custom designs, and reliable service, Texas Sugar Daddies brings a personal touch to every order and event.
